title: Events
empty: No orders in this period: no event to compare.

key.label: Tint: units sold per 100 orders of the event. The darker, the faster it sells.

how.cell: Each cell gives the units of this product sold at this event. "0": on sale, but nothing sold.
how.tint: The tint measures units sold per 100 orders of the event, not raw units, so a small event and a big one can be compared. The darkest goes up to {top} per 100 orders, the highest rate in the table.
how.absent: "—": the product was not on sale at this event, because it arrived later or was already sold out.
how.total: Total: the units sold over the whole period, outside events included.

tip.units: {event}: {count} sold, {rate} per 100 orders | {event}: {count} sold, {rate} per 100 orders
